benchmark: Round454 matched full PPO replay with per-record static team cache keys
finding: All 82 final model tensors and all numeric training metrics matched Round447 exactly. Run ID, checkpoint path, and wall-clock timestamp naturally differ. The full replay took 228.62 s, effectively identical to Round453’s 228.64 s; sample preparation took 163.68 s vs Round453’s 163.07 s, so this replay did not show an additional end-to-end speed gain from precomputing team signatures. It was 3.21% faster in sample preparation than Round447, but that comparison includes multiple changes and run-to-run timing variation.
limitations: PPO update only; self-play rollout generation excluded. The isolated cache-key benchmark measures input construction but not the full update. Do not update complete-iteration games/s from this replay.
